name: Probabilistic Voxel Representation
definition: A real-time instance-level open-vocabulary probabilistic voxel representation that uses probabilistic modeling to enhance robustness in incremental mapping, associating instances from observed masks and maps by solving Maximum Likelihood Estimation (MLE) and updating voxel instance vectors and codebooks by solving Maximum A Posteriori (MAP).
summary: Probabilistic Voxel Representation is a real-time mapping method that models voxel occupancy and semantic identity through probabilistic distributions to enhance robustness in incremental 3D reconstruction.
